themes.name: Fried alligator
themes.description: Reviews discussing the fried alligator appetizer, including its texture, tenderness, batter, chili garlic mayo or aioli, and how it compares with other alligator.

themes.name: Wood-fired oysters
themes.description: Reviews discussing the wood-fired or grilled oysters with chili garlic butter, including their flavor, sauce, doneness, and how they are plated.

themes.name: Louisiana Cochon entree
themes.description: Reviews discussing the signature Louisiana Cochon pulled pork dish with cabbage, turnips and cracklins, including its moistness, flavor, and whether it lives up to being the namesake dish.

themes.name: Rabbit and dumplings
themes.description: Reviews discussing the rabbit and dumplings stew, including the amount of rabbit, the dumplings or biscuits, the gravy, and seasoning.

themes.name: Mac and cheese
themes.description: Reviews discussing the macaroni and cheese casserole side or small plate, including its creaminess, crust, and seasoning.

themes.name: Gumbo
themes.description: Reviews discussing any of the gumbos (chicken and andouille, duck, deviled egg), including roux, flavor, consistency, and portion.

themes.name: Smoked ribs
themes.description: Reviews discussing the spicy or smoked pork ribs with pickled watermelon, including tenderness, sauce, and smoke flavor.

themes.name: Pork cheeks
themes.description: Reviews discussing the braised or crispy pork cheek small plate, including tenderness, accompaniments, and portion.

themes.name: Brisket
themes.description: Reviews discussing the smoked beef brisket entree and its horseradish potato salad.

themes.name: Boudin
themes.description: Reviews discussing the fried boudin balls or boudin appetizer, including crust, filling, and flavor.

themes.name: Bread and rolls
themes.description: Reviews discussing the complimentary dinner rolls or bread and butter, including their quality, timing, and whether refills are given.

themes.name: Desserts
themes.description: Reviews discussing the dessert menu, such as the pineapple upside-down cake, puddings, pies, and ice cream.

themes.name: Cocktails and drinks
themes.description: Reviews discussing the quality, variety, and pricing of cocktails, wine, beer, whiskey, and other beverages. Service by the bartender is covered under Waitstaff service.

themes.name: Waitstaff service
themes.description: Reviews discussing the conduct of servers, bartenders, runners and managers once the guest is at the table, including attentiveness, friendliness, menu knowledge, pacing, rushing, and handling of complaints or requests.

themes.name: Host stand and wait times
themes.description: Reviews discussing reservations, the hostesses and greeting at the door, quoted versus actual wait times, seating decisions, and walk-in or party-size policies.

themes.name: Price and portions
themes.description: Reviews discussing the cost of the meal, value for money, and how big or small portions and small plates are.

themes.name: Atmosphere and noise
themes.description: Reviews discussing the decor, ambiance, seating comfort, table spacing, temperature, noise level, and overall vibe of the dining room or bar.

themes.name: Cochon Butcher
themes.description: Reviews that mention the neighboring sister sandwich shop Cochon Butcher, including mix-ups between the two and recommendations to visit it instead.
